evidence.citation: Artifact: "Stop and ask the user to define a real per-case judgment bar... Clarify whether it is judgment- or conformance-oriented, then echo the agreed bar before running any agents."
evidence.criterion: C1: The artifact does not require materially unnecessary execution work under the supplied cost evaluation bar.

rationale: The artifact requires clarifying the actual evaluation bar and orientation before any run is spent. Under the supplied cost bar, work that establishes the requested outcome and evaluation validity is necessary, not materially unnecessary execution work.
